# devcontainerbuilder Provider

Wraps a devcontainer-builder service instance's POST /build, GET /image, and DELETE /image endpoints.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    devcontainerbuilder = {
      source = "deepspacecartel/devcontainer-builder"
    }
  }
}

provider "devcontainerbuilder" {
  # Both attributes also read from DEVCONTAINERBUILDER_ENDPOINT /
  # DEVCONTAINERBUILDER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT if unset here - a running
  # devcontainer-builder instance (see
  # https://github.com/DeepSpaceCartel/devcontainer-builder), not something
  # this provider deploys itself.
  endpoint        = "http://devcontainer-builder.devcontainer-builder.svc.cluster.local:8080"
  request_timeout = "30m"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the devcontainer-builder service, no trailing slash (e.g. http://devcontainer-builder.ns.svc:8080). Falls back to the DEVCONTAINERBUILDER_ENDPOINT environment variable.
- `request_timeout` (String) Per-request timeout as a Go duration string (e.g. "30m"). Builds are unbounded clone+build+push calls, so this needs to be generous. Falls back to the DEVCONTAINERBUILDER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT environment variable, defaulting to "30m".
